page.layout: One page of text, centred title page; a woodcut engraving in the middle; no margin notes. Page number 3 printed at top right corner.
page.notes: Woodcut vignette between the edition line and the imprint, showing a hand-and-tool or flaming emblem among rocks and clouds. Handwritten date "1586" in pencil/ink below the imprint, not printed text, so omitted. The title's "ARITHME-TICAE" is broken at the line end with a printed hyphen; "DE-DVCTA" likewise. Long s printed as f-like forms in "fecunda", "profeffioris" were transcribed as plain s; "Ursti-sii" rendered as printed "VRSTISII".
